notes.title: Pyun Pyun Heart Throbbing Endless Love Bakery - A Bonnie's Bakery Spin-Off Game!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=qu4IxZM7znw;full][/previewyoutube]

Explore the world of Bonnie's Bakery through another lens in this brand new visual novel! 

Our newest game just launched a Kickstarter page! You can help us by backing this game on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1205487879/pyun-pyun-heart-throbbing-endless-love-bakery?ref=2duu2a]Kickstarter[/url] or wishlisting it here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3010930/Pyun_Pyun_Heart_Throbbing_Endless_Love_Bakery/]Steam[/url]! The demo is also available to play right now on [url=https://melty-clown-studio.itch.io/pyun-pyun-heart-throbbing-endless-love-bakery]itch.io[/url]!

This demo has been in the works for quite some time now, and we're excited to show you all the things we've been working on!

- SoupDev
